title: Mark a saved project view offline
responsibility: Marks a phone’s saved snapshot as dated and read-only without claiming it is current or published.

inputs.name: cachedSnapshot.snapshot
inputs.description: The saved project snapshot whose project identity, branch, commit and visible content should be retained.

inputs.name: cachedSnapshot.saved
inputs.description: The saved timestamp and the identity of the phone holding this copy. These values are copied without date or identity validation.

outputs.name: cachedSnapshot
outputs.description: A new snapshot with writing disabled and replacement offline cache metadata. Publication is unknown; the cache identity uses the phone, project, branch and commit while unavailable repository, tree and revision details use empty, zero or null values. Existing capabilities and other content remain as supplied.
